selected.item: Gemini API expanded Office and OpenDocument file support: the Gemini API now accepts PowerPoint 97-2003 (PPT), OpenDocument Presentation (ODP), and OpenDocument Spreadsheet (ODS) files as input, and adds page-image processing for Word 97-2003 (DOC) files. DOC, PPT, and ODP files are rendered as page images. For ODS files, the model receives the data and formulas from the first sheet. Also: tools can now return Office and OpenDocument files, audio, and video to the model in function responses; GenerateContent API function response parts now accept audio, video, and Office and OpenDocument files in addition to images, PDFs, and plain text, and accept fileData so tools can return a Files API URI instead of inline bytes.
